item: The storage-events budget test no longer measures a different journal size on a loaded machine
summary: test_the_storage_events_budget_holds_a_full_journal pins the widest journal to the byte (124,251), and the fixture's runs carried seconds = 99,999.999 plus however long the hooks took between the fixture setting started and the run's end, so a loaded machine wrote 100000.0 or 100000.002 and the size moved (124,250 once in three runs under xdist -n 6, field checks lane; a 1 ms pause gave 124,223). The fixture now stops the clock storage_events reads (only that module's name, only while the runs are written), so the seconds are exactly the fixture's. Test-only; no release-notes line.
